summary.en: A glossy copper green over feldspar and wood ash, poured in bold areas beside iron painting.

safety.en: Copper oxide is harmful to breathe and fumes in the kiln: vent the kiln. A copper glaze can leach copper on food surfaces; test it.

sources.citation: "Developing a Cone 6 Traditional Oribe Glaze" (anonymous blog, 2024-01-26, updated 2024-06-27), quoting Touroji's recipe.
Krichev J. and Coppage R., "Oribe Ware", Ceramics Monthly, February 2025.
吉田博和, 尾上彩, 常世田茂, 佐藤剛「笠間焼の新素地・新釉薬の開発」, 茨城県工業技術センター研究報告 第43号 (2014), Table 6.

gaps: The recipe comes from a blog quoting Touroji; Touroji's own page or a Japanese test-centre Oribe recipe is not yet opened.
Synthetic ash stands in for the wood ash the recipe names.
Mikawa feldspar and synthetic wood ash are not in the standard library yet (branch r14-native-materials).
